text: {"ops":[{"op":"add","content":"When a scheduled event or meeting’s time changes, replace the old entry with the new one rather than adding a duplicate; maintain the old entry until it is superseded.","weight":1.5},{"op":"add","content":"Drop promotional newsletters, marketing emails, and other low‑signal items; never store them to keep memory clean.","weight":1.5},{"op":"add","content":"Retain any scheduled event that is due within the next 7 days even if it has no explicit deadline; otherwise drop it after 3 days without a future follow‑up action.","weight":1.0}]}
